title: Underwhelming desk - concerns for longevity
text:
Underwhelming desk - concerns for longevity. Overall, this desk looks nice but leaves me concerned with its longevity due to flimsy feeling materials.

Pros: the desk looks nice, and is the advertised size. Height seems good, but I don’t yet have chairs to see how well it fits with a standard height chair. Relatively easy to assemble. Minimal screws and parts made it easier for me to assemble myself. The desk is also surprisingly light, and moves easily across the carpet for positioning. Metal Frame seems sturdy.

Cons: one of the tops came damaged, and shows just how thin the veneer on the top board is. The biggest con for me is how flimsy the whole top feels when any sort of weight is put on it. This seems to be largely due to the top support plank, which runs from one end to the other (also mdf). I believe it’s supposed to prop both of the desk top halves up to support the middle of the desk, but as you can see in the photo, this board was flexed and does not support both sides. Additionally, all screws were hand tightened, but you can see how the screw posts pulled into the soft mdf, immediately damaging. These will loosen up quickly over normal use of the desk and don’t leave me confident this desk will last very long with two people using it. Lastly, the description advertises cable management via the desk holes, but it also mentions built in usb ports, which are not on this desk. Misleading advertising.
